title: Fistful of bricks
description: This mod adds the ability to throw bricks, but unlike other mods this one also adds bricks for all brick blocks, new effects and changes recipes
body:
**Fistful of bricks** is a mod that adds the ability to use bricks as ranged weapons, aka. throwing.
It separates itself from other mods of this type by also adding new brick items(some with special properties), new effects and altering brick block recipes.

New mechanics:
- Throwable bricks
- Smashable glass

New bricks:
- Stone brick
- Mossy stone brick
- Deepslate brick
- Tuff brick
- Mud brick
- Prismarine brick
- Red nether brick
- Blackstone brick
- Endstone brick
- Quartz brick

New status effects:
- Stun (briefly removes target's ability to move or attack)
- Ensnared (slows down all of target's movements by 20%/level)
